```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ragnar)
```


::: callout-note
Remember to rotate sideways pages before extractions
:::

# Create Initial Store

```{r}
store <- ragnar_store_create(
  "manual.duckdb",
  embed = NULL
)
```

# Once initial store created, read back in for editing.

```{r}
store <- ragnar_store_connect(
  "manual.duckdb",
  read_only = FALSE
)
```

# Reading in Documents

## Matrix Activities

```{r}
matrix_act <- read_as_markdown("manuals/matrix_redact.pdf")

#View full  
#cat(as.character(matrix_act))

#Chunking
matrix_act_c <- markdown_chunk(
  matrix_act,
  target_size = 1600,
  target_overlap = .2
)

#View
cat(matrix_act_c$text[1])
ragnar_chunks_view(matrix_act_c)

#Insert document chunks
ragnar_store_insert(store, matrix_act_c)
```

# Indexing RAG

Run every time store is updated.

```{r}
ragnar_store_build_index(store, type = "fts")

ragnar_store_inspect(store)
```
